title: Research data-link plans
bodyMd:
### Usage forecast
A field station expects to transmit900GB each month. It requires a backup link independent of the main link. A backup carrying any monthly traffic must be able to carry the entire forecast if the main link fails.

### Offers
Plan Ridge provides1000GB per month for180 euros and cannot be combined with another plan from the same provider as an independent backup. Plan Shore provides600GB for120 euros; extra traffic costs0.20 euros per GB without a volume limit. Plan Valley provides950GB for210 euros. All three plans have different providers.

### Decision rule
Choose two different-provider plans capable of900GB each. Compare their combined monthly cost assuming each carries exactly900GB during the month. Reliability differences are ignored for this exercise.
